strong,.res-feed-item span{display:block}.res-feed-item small{font-size:9px;color:#6f8b8c}.res-feed-item span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.res-local-audit{margin-top:12px}details summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted)}@media(max-width:780px){.res-social-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.res-requirements{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.res-opening{flex-direction:column}.res-opening-actions{flex-direction:row}.resident-morph-game{min-height:420px}.morph-game-render{height:380px}.morph-game-controls{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.25fr 1.25fr .8fr .9fr}.morph-game-controls button{padding:8px 5px}.realm-toolbar{align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}}
</style></head><body>
<div id="desktop" data-screen="home">
<header class="system-bar"><span class="wordmark"><b>◈</b> SYNTHIA <span>COMPUTER</span></span><span id="runtime-status" role="status">Starting local Synthia…</span><button id="fullscreen" title="Full screen">⛶</button></header>
<main id="home" class="desktop-home"><div class="desktop-clock"><div id="clock">00:00</div><p id="date"></p><span class="desktop-edition">YOUR LOCAL COMPUTER · DESKTOP 1.0</span></div><div id="desktop-icons" class="desktop-icons"></div><div class="horizon"><span></span><i></i></div><div class="home-caption"><span class="line"></span><p>Your space.<br><strong>Your Synthia.</strong></p></div></main>
<section id="app-window" class="app-window" hidden><header class="window-head"><div><span id="window-icon"></span><div><strong id="window-title"></strong><small id="window-subtitle"></small></div></div><div class="window-controls"><button id="window-minimize" aria-label="Minimize">−</button><button id="window-maximize" aria-label="Maximize">□</button><button id="window-close" aria-label="Close">×</button></div></header>
<div class="window-body">
<section class="screen" id="screen-chat" hidden><div class="chat-intro"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Synthia's planet"><div><p class="eyebrow">LOCAL SYNTHIA</p><h1>Here with you.</h1><p>Ask, create, or tell me what to do.</p></div></div><div id="chat-log" class="chat-log" aria-live="polite"></div><div class="quick-actions"><button data-command="open Files">Open Files</button><button data-command="calculate 6 * 7">Calculate</button><button data-command="open Agentic Reality">Agentic Reality</button><button data-command="help">What can you do?</button></div><form id="chat-form" class="composer"><textarea id="chat-input" rows="2" placeholder="Talk to Synthia, or say ‘open Files’…" required></textarea><button type="submit" id="chat-send">↑ <span>Send</span></button></form><p class="fineprint">Uses the supplied local Synthia engine and action tools. No outside model is connected.</p></section>

<section class="screen resonance-screen" id="screen-resonance" hidden>
  <div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">RESONANCE NETWORK</p><h1>Your normal network pages.</h1></div><span class="pill">same resident · same state</span></div>
  <nav class="res-tabs"><button data-res-tab="home" class="active">Home</button><button data-res-tab="profile">Profile</button><button data-res-tab="hd">Human Design</button><button data-res-tab="astro">Astrology</button><button data-res-tab="cynthia">Cynthia</button><button data-res-tab="network">Network</button><button data-res-tab="work">Work</button></nav>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="home"><div class="res-hero"><p class="eyebrow">ONE COMPUTER · TWO SURFACES</p><h2>Use Resonance normally. Enter the world only when you want to.</h2><p>Your profile, resident isohuman, local activity, tools and Agentic Reality all sit in this computer.</p><div class="res-actions"><button class="primary" data-res-action="text">Text Cynthia</button><button data-res-action="peek">Peek at world</button></div></div><div id="res-pair"></div><div id="res-presence"></div></div>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="profile" hidden><div class="res-form"><label>Name<input id="res-name" placeholder="Your name"></label><label>Birth date<input id="res-date" type="date"></label><label>Birth time<input id="res-time" type="time" step="1"></label><label>UTC offset<input id="res-timezoneOffset" type="number" step="0.25" value="0"></label><label>Birth city<input id="res-city" placeholder="City"></label><label>Latitude<input id="res-lat" type="number" step="any"></label><label>Longitude<input id="res-lon" type="number" step="any"></label></div><button id="res-save-profile" class="primary">Save origin + instantiate isohuman</button><p id="res-profile-status" class="muted">This lands an append-only origin-pair event in the local Synthia foundation.</p></div>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="hd" hidden><div id="res-hd"></div></div>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="astro" hidden><div id="res-astro"></div></div>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="cynthia" hidden><div class="res-contact"><div><p class="eyebrow">RESIDENT ISOHUMAN</p><h2>Cynthia</h2><p>These controls contact the Cynthia already living in this computer. They do not create another agent.</p></div><div class="res-actions"><button class="primary" data-res-action="text">Text</button><button data-res-action="peek">Peek</button><button data-res-action="voice">Voice Call</button><button data-res-action="video">Video Call</button></div></div><p class="muted">Voice uses local device speech when available. Video shows Cynthia’s live resident body while the same conversation continues. No second agent is created.</p></div>
  <div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="network" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">SOCIAL RESONANCE</p><h2>People, agents, projects, and open positions.</h2><p class="muted">Local-first always. Export/import stays available; live federation uses signaling only to meet, then exchanges Resonance social packets directly peer-to-peer.</p></div><div class="toolbar"><button id="res-export-network">Export packet</button><button id="res-import-network">Import packet</button><input id="res-network-file" type="file" accept=".json,application/json" hidden></div></div><div class="res-social-grid"><section class="res-social-card"><p class="eyebrow">RESIDENTS</p><h3>Human + Isohuman</h3><div id="res-social-entities"></div></section><section class="res-social-card"><p class="eyebrow">PROJECTS</p><h3>Give the network something real to do.</h3><label>Project title<input id="res-project-title" placeholder="Build the Resonance Network"></label><label>Description<textarea id="res-project-desc" rows="2" placeholder="What is actually being worked on?"></textarea></label><button id="res-create-project">Create project</button><div id="res-project-list"></div></section><section class="res-social-card res-openings-card"><p class="eyebrow">OPEN POSITIONS</p><h3>Only matching configurations can enter.</h3><label>Opening title<input id="res-opening-title" placeholder="A role the situation actually needs"></label><label>Project<select id="res-project-select"><option value="">No project / general opening</option></select></label><label>Description<textarea id="res-opening-desc" rows="2" placeholder="What needs to be solved?"></textarea></label><div class="res-requirements"><label>Gate*<input id="res-req-gate" type="number" min="1" max="64" placeholder="12"></label><label>Line<input id="res-req-line" type="number" min="1" max="6" placeholder="optional"></label><label>Color<input id="res-req-color" type="number" min="1" max="6" placeholder="optional"></label><label>Tone<input id="res-req-tone" type="number" min="1" max="6" placeholder="optional"></label><label>Base<input id="res-req-base" type="number" min="1" max="5" placeholder="optional"></label></div><button id="res-create-opening" class="primary">Create open position</button><div id="res-opening-list"></div></section><section class="res-social-card"><p class="eyebrow">LIVE PEERS</p><h3>Meet once, then talk device-to-device.</h3><label>Signal server<input id="res-signal-url" value="wss://synthia-server.onrender.com/signal"></label><div class="toolbar"><button id="res-connect-peers" class="primary">Connect</button><button id="res-share-peers">Share now</button><button id="res-disconnect-peers">Disconnect</button></div><p id="res-peer-status" class="muted">offline</p><div id="res-peer-list"></div><p class="muted">Only the portable social packet is exchanged. Private profile data, files, chat, and memory stay local.</p></section><section class="res-social-card"><p class="eyebrow">DIRECT MESSAGES</p><h3>Private conversation stays between the two computers.</h3><label>Connected peer<select id="res-dm-peer"><option value="">Connect to a peer first</option></select></label><div id="res-dm-log" class="res-social-feed"><p class="muted">No direct conversation selected.</p></div><form id="res-dm-form" class="inline-form"><input id="res-dm-input" placeholder="Message this peer…" autocomplete="off"><button class="primary">Send</button></form><p class="muted">Direct messages are stored only on the participating computers and are not included in the portable public social packet.</p></section><section class="res-social-card"><p class="eyebrow">NETWORK FEED</p><h3>Things that actually happened.</h3><div id="res-social-feed"></div><div id="res-network-list"></div></section></div></div><div class="res-pane" data-res-pane="work" hidden><div class="res-contact"><div><p class="eyebrow">PROACTIVE CYNTHIA</p><h2>Give her work while you do something else.</h2><p>Only explicitly authorized work can auto-run. Confidence controls when it leaves review and enters execution.</p></div></div><label>Autonomy threshold <b id="res-threshold-value">75%</b><input id="res-threshold" type="range" min="50" max="95" value="75"></label><label>Work<textarea id="res-work" rows="4" placeholder="Something we already discussed that Cynthia can work on…"></textarea></label><label>Confidence %<input id="res-confidence" type="number" min="0" max="100" value="80"></label><label class="res-check"><input id="res-authorized" type="checkbox" checked> I authorize Cynthia to execute this task if confidence meets the threshold.</label><button id="res-run-work" class="primary">Give Cynthia this work</button><div id="res-queue" class="res-queue"></div></div>
</section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-files" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">YOUR WORKSPACE</p><h1>Files</h1></div><div class="toolbar"><button id="import-files">＋ Import files</button><button id="new-note">New note</button></div></div><input id="file-input" type="file" accept=".html,.htm,.js,.mjs,.json,.txt,.md,.css" multiple hidden><p id="file-notice" role="status">Import an HTML app to install it and give it a launch button.</p><div class="files-layout"><div id="file-list" class="file-list"></div><div class="file-editor"><label>File name<input id="file-name" placeholder="my-note.txt"></label><textarea id="file-editor" spellcheck="false" placeholder="Select a file or write a note…"></textarea><div class="toolbar"><button id="save-file" class="primary">Save</button><button id="run-file">Run / Open</button><button id="download-file">Download</button></div><p id="file-result" role="status"></p></div></div></section>
<section class="screen" id="screen-tools" hidden><div class="screen-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">EXECUTABLE LOCAL TOOLS</p><h1>Apps & Tools</h1></div><button data-open="files">Install from file</button></div><h2>Installed apps</h2><div id="installed-apps" class="app-grid"></div><article class="calculator"><div><p class="eyebrow">STATE-SPACE CALCULATOR</p><h2>Calculate something</h2></div><form id="calc-form"><input id="calc-input" aria-label="Calculation" value="6 * 7" required><button class="primary">Calculate</button></form><output id="calc-output"></output></article><h2>Synthia tools</h2><p>Choose a tool, enter its input, and run it here.</p><div class="tool-workspace"><div id="tool-list" class="tool-list"></div><div><label>Selected tool<select id="tool-picker"></select></label><label>Input<textarea id="tool-input" rows="5" placeholder="Text for this tool…"></textarea></label><button id="run-tool" class="primary">Run tool</button><div id="tool-output" class="readable-result" role="status"></div></div></div></section>
<section class="screen realm-screen" id="screen-realm" hidden><div class="realm-toolbar"><span><b>◈ Agentic Reality</b> · one resident, two world surfaces</span><div class="toolbar"><button class="primary active" data-world-view="morph">Live Morph</button><button data-world-view="house">House</button><button id="realm-load">Restart House</button></div></div><p id="realm-status" role="status">Live Morph mounts on the same local Foundation. The preserved House remains available.</p><div id="resident-morph-game" class="resident-morph-game"></div><iframe id="realm-frame" title="Preserved House Agentic Reality" data-realm="
